name: The Girl in Red: The Intrusive Chapter
source:
One knock. One stranger. And suddenly, Julia’s ordinary evening spirals into a nightmare.

[From [url=https://inkiibanana.itch.io/the-girl-in-red]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一陣敲門聲。一個陌生人。轉眼間，朱莉婭平凡的夜晚就急轉直下，變成了一場惡夢。
